enrichment.animation: Rigid transform groups; no skins, clips, external textures or third-party assets. Runtime applies bounded motion relative to authored pivots and pauses it during reading and reduced-motion mode.
enrichment.detailPoster: poster-detail.webp in each room model directory; generated from a second authored camera and recorded in that room export-report.json
enrichment.review: Original local procedural geometry. Illustrated roles are fictional; historical source review and physical-device visual acceptance remain pending.

historicalStatus: Illustrative environments; not exact reconstructions. No historical recordings, documents, or maps are presented as authentic.

archive.scope: Fictional time-travel archive. Textures and contour marks are original decorative patterns.
archive.review: User instructed Continue after the first-room preview. Baked poster lighting is available; runtime asset uses textured PBR materials and direct lighting without baked ambient occlusion.

ww1-field-station.scope: Illustrative Western Front communications shelter: timber retaining walls, sandbags, field telephone, dispatch table and supply parcels. Not an exact site or equipment replica.
ww1-field-station.review: Authored locally. Historical source review and physical-device visual acceptance remain pending. No authentic documents or markings.

ww2-radio-room.scope: Illustrative British civilian interior with a wooden radio, blackout curtains, armchairs and household books. Not a documented person's home or a specific radio model.
ww2-radio-room.review: Authored locally. Historical source review and physical-device visual acceptance remain pending. No authentic broadcasts or recordings.

kingdom-court.scope: Illustrative, culturally non-specific royal court with a raised ceremonial area, manuscript table, and courtyard threshold. Not a reconstruction of a named palace or kingdom.
kingdom-court.review: Authored locally from procedural geometry and materials. No authentic documents, maps, or architectural claims.

market-port.scope: Illustrative Nusantara maritime trading port with a wooden pier, canvas market stalls, a moored ship, and stacked cargo. Not a reconstruction of a named port, ship, or historical cargo.
market-port.review: Authored locally from procedural geometry and materials. Generated with Blender 5.2.1 LTS on this host. No authentic documents, maps, manifests, or cargo records.
